A Substantial  Six-Bedroom Detached Family Home in an  End-of-Cul-de-Sac Setting

Athy, Co. Kildare 0598638388

A rare opportunity to acquire a beautifully presented six-bedroom detached family home,  positioned at the end of a quiet and private cul-de-sac. This exceptional property offers generous and versatile accommodation throughout, with a wonderful combination of space, quality, character and modern family living.

The house has been carefully maintained and thoughtfully finished, with numerous features that set it apart. Decorative coving, dado rails and wainscoting panelling add character and elegance, while the quality flooring and extensive built-in storage provide both style and practicality.

At the heart of the home is a superb, generously proportioned kitchen, fitted with an impressive range of quality units and a large central island finished with a quartz worktop. The kitchen is exceptionally well equipped with Miele appliances, including 2 ovens, a steam oven and microwave/oven, making this an ideal space for both family life and entertaining.

The kitchen has a particularly attractive connection to the spacious sunroom, with elegant French doors together with a further wide-open entrance providing an additional access between the two rooms. This clever arrangement creates an exceptional sense of openness and flow between the kitchen and sunroom, while still allowing the areas to be used independently. The sunroom provides a wonderful additional living and entertaining space, with a direct connection towards the rear garden.

The accommodation continues with a choice of excellent reception rooms, including a generous living room, sitting room and separate TV room. These rooms benefit from beautiful acacia flooring, providing a warm and distinctive finish and complementing the traditional features throughout the home.

A dedicated home office is an additional and increasingly desirable feature. With extensive fitted shelving, it provides an ideal environment for working from home, studying or simply having a quiet space away from the main living accommodation. The office, together with the kitchen, utility, hall and sunroom, all benefit from attractive porcelain tiled flooring.

The bedroom accommodation is equally impressive. There are six well-proportioned bedrooms, all featuring solid timber oak flooring and built-in wardrobes, providing excellent storage throughout. Ensuite facilities further enhance the bedroom accommodation plus a family bathroom , while radiator covers throughout add an attractive finishing touch.

The property also benefits from a downstairs WC and separate utility room, adding considerably to its practicality as a family home. Heating is provided by oil-fired central heating.

Beautiful Rear Garden

The rear of the property is particularly appealing, with a beautifully maintained lawned garden offering privacy and plenty of space for family enjoyment.

A large cobble-lock patio area provides an excellent outdoor entertaining space, ideal for summer dining, barbecues or simply relaxing in the garden. The combination of generous lawn and substantial patio creates a garden that is both attractive and highly practical.

The relationship between the kitchen, sunroom and rear garden is particularly impressive, with the multiple points of access creating an excellent flow for entertaining and everyday family life.

A Location That Has It All

The property enjoys a superb position within this quiet residential cul-de-sac, offering peace and privacy while remaining exceptionally convenient to the amenities of Athy.

The People’s Park is just a pleasant stroll from the property, providing a wonderful nearby amenity for walking, recreation, enjoying the outdoors.

For commuters, the location is particularly attractive, with Athy railway station just three minutes from the property. The station provides regular direct weekday services to Dublin Heuston, making commuting to Dublin both practical and convenient. Alternatively going south to Carlow,Kilkenny and Waterford.

The combination of the peaceful end-of-cul-de-sac setting, The People’s Park within easy walking distance, excellent local amenities and superb rail connectivity makes this an outstanding location for modern family life.

A Home Designed for Family Living

This is a substantial home that offers an exceptional level of flexibility. With six bedrooms, multiple reception rooms, a superb kitchen, spacious sunroom, dedicated home office, excellent storage and a beautiful private rear garden, there is ample space for a growing family, entertaining guests and working from home.

The quality of the finishes, generous proportions and attention to detail are evident throughout, while the enviable location adds significantly to the property's appeal.

A spacious family residence in a great  location, offering space, privacy, quality and convenience in equal measure. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this exceptional home has to offer.
